title: 2009 Prairie's stone basement now stands as tall as its photograph
items: In 1904, the brownstone basement of 2009 Prairie Avenue now rises in three rough-faced courses over its three small windows, with a smooth stone band above them up to the ground-floor sill, as the old photograph shows. Before, the smooth band sat half a metre too low.
The chimney's place, the window hoods, the oriel's carved underside and the gable's south foot are still to come.
